action: Called Linda Park directly for fleet introduction; completed SQL Module 4; followed up on Maria Santos grant; confirmed collaboration loop with Tom Bradley
narrative: Priya called Linda Park directly and made her case clearly — she identified herself as a peer to Tom in the same transition, cited her SQL coursework at Module 4, and asked explicitly for consideration in the same fleet and logistics outreach. Linda took the call without irritation and was genuinely receptive: she told Priya she was already aware of her background and would include her name in the next outreach to the regional logistics contact, but she could not speak for a third party's hiring timeline. It is not an introduction yet — it is a commitment to make one. The Maria Santos grant office confirmed receipt of Priya's application and said decisions are being processed in the order received, with most applicants hearing back within ten to fourteen days. Priya completed Module 4 — window functions and subqueries — in three evening sessions and updated her LinkedIn profile and application materials to reflect the completion. Tom Bradley confirmed she is in the loop for Linda's introductions. None of this produced income this tick, and with $617 in savings and $3,341 in monthly expenses, the math is now in days rather than months — but the Linda signal is the most substantive advance toward income that Priya has had.
